packs.t01: Build the table for a game yourself. Scrape it out of a spreadsheet and paste — the first row is the column names, the first column is the name, and a “image” column is used as the picture address.
packs.browseLead: These are tables other people uploaded. Press “Take it over” and it becomes your table, ready for a game as it is. Everyone who plays the same table meets on {board}.
packs.t17: Build a table of what you like and the games run on it!
packs.t21: Copied — but the table is large, so the address is long. Some apps may cut it off.
packs.t22: The address is copied. Whoever opens it gets that table.
packs.t24: Sign in and this table goes up by itself — off to Discord for a moment.
packs.t26: Press “Make this table” just like this.
packs.t27: It could not be saved in this browser (private mode, or no room).
packs.t28: Paste the address you were given
packs.t29: No table could be read from that address.
packs.t30: No table could be read from the address you were given.
packs.t33: Other people’s tables could not be fetched just now. Your own tables still play fine.
packs.t34: There is no table by that name.
packs.t35: No table has been uploaded yet — make one under “My tables” and upload it.
packs.t36: It could not be taken over. Please press again in a moment.

packs.msg.uploaded: “{title}” is up — it now stands in Browse, and this table gets its own leaderboard.
packs.msg.received: “{title}” arrived. Send it to a game below.
packs.msg.uploadedOne: “{title}” is up — it now stands in Browse.
packs.t37: Put the column names on the first row, and one entry per row below it.
packs.t38: There is not a single entry.
packs.t39: Besides the name there must be at least one column to compare (e.g. kind, age, height).
packs.t40: It needs more than four entries to make a game.
